crew.overview: Each member of a family in Taipei asks hard questions about life's meaning as they live through everyday quandaries. NJ is morose: his brother owes him money, his mother-in-law is in a coma, his wife suffers a spiritual crisis when she finds her life a blank and his business partners make bad decisions.
crew.title: Yi Yi

details.biography: Chen Po Wen (Chinese: 陳博文; born in 1953) is a Taiwanese film editor. In 1974, he graduated from the Department of Radio and Television of the National Taiwan Junior College of Arts. He first worked as a script clerk and assistant director, before launching a career as a film editor under the guidance of editor Huang Chiu-kuei (黃秋貴). He has won the the Golden Horse Best Film Editing Awards for Do Over (2006) and Darkness and Light (1999).
details.name: Chen Po-Wen
